source_layer: Fixed catalog hypothesis; author webpage/runtime not fetched or verified in this preparation; no author fulltext prerequisite for this separately authorized hypothesis.
authorization_boundary: Assigned root/m0288 for implementation and C0; history requires independent actual-code QA and coordinator release. No other IDs or new controls assigned.
instrument: Bitcoin retained; Binance spot BTCUSDT quote/venue is explicit research instance, not original author assertion.
input_period: 2022-12-01T00:00:00Z through2025-01-01T00:00:00Z exclusive; do not change input
evaluation: 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z through2025-01-01T00:00:00Z exclusive; full24calendar months including initial cash/readiness period. Prior exposed availability-selected window, NOT OOS.
monthly_reporting: Month return=end equity/previous month end equity-1; first denominator100000. Continuous account and indicators, no monthly resetting or selective omission of cash/zero-trade months.

capital.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
capital.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent
capital.independent_QA: Independent money/quantity fields compare exact Decimal numerical equality with no tolerance/quantization; nonnumeric identity/time/counter fields exact. Different trailing-zero representations from equivalent normal-domain oracle algebra are retained as QA evidence, not accepted if values differ. Same implementation recovery remains byte-exact. No blanket all-Decimal-domain equivalence claim.

execution.at_open: Execute earliest-due pending action if due_index<=currentindex and actual holdings permit. Stale is logged/discarded; no sameopen roundtrip or reentry. No out-of-window fill.
at_close_sequence: Update completed-bar indicators. Compute raw entry and exit independent of holdings.
Raw opposite event cancels pending opposite intent before position gating; if both events arise exit/cancel-buy has priority.
Schedule buy only if flat and raw entry; sell only if long and raw exit.
Same-direction repeat retains original earliest due; absent event does not cancel an existing intent.
All calendar labels refer to UTC bar-open date; signal close knowledge becomes actionable at following bar open or declared lag2.
No warmup intents; no price filter, indicator, weekday/holiday exclusions or extra exit.
execution.lag2: Raw opposite event at t+1 cancels pending intent due t+2. Absence of event retains original intent/due, no repeated deferral.

valuation: Endbar equity=cash+quantity*rawclose. No funding/interest, no dividend assumptions needed for spot BTC. No terminal liquidation or hypothetical exit fee; report residual inventory and pending action separately. No fill outside evaluation.

identity.precision: Decimal50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN from raw decimal text
identity.exit: none; no fictitious terminal fee or liquidation

benchmark.comparison: One existing base-cost control referenced for all four strategy cases; do not describe it as fee0/fee20 matched control. No new benchmark execution authorized.
benchmark.verification_limit: Read and hash existing Git acceptance evidence; no new private NAV read or restore run in this draft.

precision: Decimal50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN from input decimal strings for cash/holdings. No price indicator or indicator seed exists. Conversion to float only defined metrics; no price/tick rounding.
QA_gate: Recheck exact inputhash/grid/uniqueness/close_time/finite positiveOHLC/nonnegativevolume/trades/OHLC bounds; reject any failure, no imputation/drop/forwardfill. Existing QA accepted input may have low-activity bars; do not silently add volume filter. Known intradayhaltmetadata retained; dailyOHLC does not prove continuous executable liquidity; no daily-midnightoverride for2023-03-24.
stop_or_roi: No intrabar stop/ROI added when absent from catalog; gap risk borne by nextopen proxy.
known_halt: Known2023-03-24 halt is intraday; no daily-midnight override. No general tradability claim.

input.reacquire_command_template: In an isolated repository checkout without retained M0216 input.csv: python research/public-strategies/M0216/scripts/rebuild_inputs.py --raw-dir NEW_PRIVATE_RAW_DIRECTORY --staging-dir NEW_PRIVATE_STAGING_DIRECTORY
input.raw_validation: 50 fixed ZIP/CHECKSUM objects,25 provider checksum andZIPCRC; canonical byte rebuild; no current finality or PIT guarantee.

statistics.base_series: 731 raw daily-close equity values including cash days, with initial100000 prepended only for returns/drawdown
statistics.sharpe_zero_cash: mean(r)/sample_std(r,ddof=1)*sqrt(365); null when standard deviation is0
statistics.monthly_return: month final equity/prior month final equity-1; firstdenominator100000; all24calendar months continuous, no reset
statistics.monthly_counts: fills by execution UTC month; days_long=endclose quantity>0; allzero activity months retained
statistics.roundtrip: a buy followed by a sell; netpnl=sale cash_after-entry cash_before; open trade excluded from win_rate
statistics.win_rate: strictly positive netpnl/closedroundtrips; zero included denominator; null if no closedtrade
statistics.exposure: endclose bars quantity>0 divided by731; no intrabar inference
statistics.fee_total: sum exact Decimal fees; represented decimaltext
statistics.floats: Decimal values converted to float64 for numpy metrics only; no float in indicators, order eligibility, allocation, valuation
statistics.serialization: CSV UTF8 csv.writer default CRLF; booleans0/1; missing empty; Decimal str no quantization; JSON indent2 UTF8 ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False newline; no timestamps in deterministic results

capital_provenance: Position sizing unspecified in operational catalog rule; root selects100%fee-inclusive spot cash. Source literal close trades are replaced by next-open/lag2 execution proxy.
cold_start: No indicator readiness requirement. 31 warmup dates cannot schedule; all731evaluationdates and24months retained.

source_original_binding.public_boundary: Ten non-rule catalog fields and literal operational excerpt separately reviewed; full original rule/internalcuration remain private under record/row/rule hashes. Graph source flags unchanged.

indicator: No price indicator or seed. Gregorian UTC daily-open date; calendar.monthrange(year,month), independent of future observed rows.
entry: At close of UTC date day == calendar month length minus 2, rawentry=true independently of holdings; if flat schedule buy.
exit: At close of UTC date day == 3, rawexit=true independently of holdings; cancel opposite pending first, if long schedule sell.

calendar_execution.interpretation: Root-selected24/7UTC interpretation of catalog trading day. Every calendar date is a trading day; no weekday/holiday calendar and no observed-last-three-row selection. Reject missing/duplicate/offgrid daily input.
calendar_execution.lag1: Third-last date close -> second-last date open buy. Day3close -> day4open sell.
calendar_execution.lag2: Third-last date close -> final date open buy. Day3close -> day5open sell.
calendar_execution.clock: Signal date is UTC bar-open date, even though close becomes known at following midnight. Do not shift calendar labels.
calendar_execution.warmup: 31 warmup bars produce no intents. Start Jan1flat; Jan3exit cannot create a sell while flat. First entry evaluated Jan29close.
calendar_execution.terminal: December29close -> December30open(lag1) or December31open(lag2); January2025exit is outside evaluation. Mark residual at Dec31close; do not force liquidation, use future rows or charge unincurred fees. Pending due outside window is logged unfilled.

economic_hypothesis: Bitcoin month-turn seasonality. Catalog says this particular window was selected from an optimization table, so selection bias is explicit; no independent author verification or statistical/OOS claim.
